Messages.Author: Chris Shorb
Messages.Body:
When I discard during someone else's turn using Giotto's special
ability, and Rachel is ready, those cards I discard go back into my
library, right?

thanks,

chris

Pertinent card text:

Rachel Brandywine [CE]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Malkavian
Group: 3
Capacity: 10
Discipline: ani AUS DEM OBF PRO
Camarilla Prince of Cleveland: If Rachel is ready, you may place cards
you discard during your discard phase in your library (shuffle
afterward). +1 bleed.

Giotto Verducci [BL]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Baali
Group: 2
Capacity: 7
Discipline: for pot pre DAI OBF
Independent: During any other Methuselah's discard phase, you may
discard a card from your hand (and draw a new one). Vampires must burn a
blood to attempt to block Giotto. Infernal.

Messages.Author: dancingmummy
Messages.Body:
Chris Shorb <chr...@vtesinla.org> wrote in message news:<3DBA1F7B...@vtesinla.org>...

> When I discard during someone else's turn using Giotto's special
> ability, and Rachel is ready, those cards I discard go back into my
> library, right?

Hi Chris!

reading the card texts, it looks like Rachel only applies during
YOUR discard phase. Giotto lets you discard during SOMEONE ELSE'S
discard phase, but that doesn't make it your discard phase, thus
Rachel doesn't apply for Neato Giotto Synergy (NGS).,

cheers,
dancingmummy



Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Chris Brown wrote:
> But what about when you Discard someone elses cards (gained via,
> Agaitas, or other uses) during your influence phase while having
> Rachel in play? Your Library or is it only cards that came from your
> Library originally?

Any card that is put into any library, crypt, or ash heap is always put
into its owner's library, crypt, or ash heap.

--

Based strictly off of card text, it looks like you can put the cards
in your library. Cards you get from Agaitas are considered "in your
hand" (see card text below), and Rachel's power does not specify that
the cards need be from your library.

Of course, the real litmus test is what LSJ thinks...
